resale_co.notes: No resale certificate of occupancy or housing resale inspection was found on the Borough website or in its posted ordinance list (2007 to 2026). The Borough site has no construction or code enforcement page. Third-party sources (not cited) say all homes in the borough are owned and administered by the Audubon Park Mutual Housing Corporation, so a home 'sale' may be a transfer handled by that corporation rather than a conventional deed sale; this is unverified. Contact the Borough Clerk (856-547-5236) to confirm.

evidence.quote: The local enforcing agency shall be the Office of the Fire Marshal in the Bureau of Fire Prevention of the Township of Haddon.
Smoke Detector/Carbon Monoxide Detector inspections shall be conducted on all one- and two-family dwellings for resale or change of occupant.
Haddon Township (Westmont, West Collingswood Heights, West Collingswood Extension) & Audubon Park
Haddon Township is the LEA for Audubon Park Borough.

fire_cert.notes: Ordinance 2023-01 (adopted March 6, 2023) replaced Ordinance 2012-05 and makes the Haddon Township Fire Marshal the local fire enforcing agency for Audubon Park under a shared services agreement. The ordinance calls the certificate a CSDCMAC (smoke detector and carbon monoxide alarm compliance). A certificate of fire code status is $25.00 under the same ordinance (not a resale item). The fire marshal contact details were read through a page summary tool because the Haddon Township site blocks plain downloads; staff listed were Chief Fire Marshal William Behnke (ext. 6269, wbehnke@haddontwp.com) and Fire Marshal Ryan Sheppard (ext. 6276, rsheppard@haddontwp.com). The volunteer Audubon Park Fire Company (856-546-6134) is a separate fire company, not the enforcing agency.
